name: Swarajya
description: Maratha hill forts: basalt walls, bhagwa saffron and monsoon green on the Sahyadri ridges. The Killedar (fort keeper) keeps watch from the bastion.
author: kite-trader project
art: Original SVG made for this project: a fort bastion with a saffron flag, a Sahyadri ridge strip and page icons. No portraits of historical figures.
